beats: The kitchen TV clock only ever showed sugar right now and weather right now — no sense of climbing, falling, or what's coming.
For a child with type 1 diabetes, that snapshot wasn't enough to plan around.
Now an SVG chart draws the last 24 hours of sugar as one line.
Above it, the next 5 hours of weather line up hour by hour.
One glance across the room now shows a full day behind and five hours ahead.
